newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Gwinnett County Water/Sewer, Ga..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Gwinnett County Water/Sewer, Ga..

text.p: OFFICIAL NOTICE OF SALE
Gwinnett County Water and Sewerage Authority (Georgia)
Revenue Bonds, Series 1997
SEALED BIDS will be received by the Gwinnett County Water and Sewerage Authority (the
Authority'') in the office
the Director Finance of Gwinnett County, 2nd Floor, Justice and Administration Building, 75 Langley Drive,
Lawrenceville, Georgia, 30245 and publicly opened at 11:00 A.M. on Tuesday,
for all, but not part of $100,000,000 in principal amount of Gwinnett County Water and Sewerage Authority (Georgia) Revenue Bonds Series 1997, (the Bonds''), as more fully described herein.

The Bonds will be issued in fully registered form in denominations of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof, as requested by the purchaser or registered owner thereof, as applicable. The Bonds will be dated June 1, 1997, and interest will be payable semiannually on February 1 and August 1 of each year beginning February 1, 1998 (the first interest payment is for eight months) until maturity, at such rate or rates of interest as are fixed by the successful bidder. Principal will be payable on August 1, 2006 and in each of the years 2011 to 2018, inclusive.
Bidders may use a Financial Surety Bond for the required good faith deposit. The official bid form may be submitted by facsimile transmission, under certain conditions.
Security: The Series 1997 Bonds will be issued and secured on a parity with the previously issued revenue bonds now outstanding in the aggregate principal amount of
$197,818,106.50 (the Prior Bonds'') and the Certificates of Participation issued in 1991, (the 1991 Certificates'')
now outstanding in the aggregate principal amount of

$54,725,000 evidencing proportionate ownership interests in certain of the basis lease payments to be made pursuant to a lease (the Prior Bonds and the 1991 Certificates are collectively referred to as the Prior Obligations'').

The Series 1997 Bonds are limited, special obligations of the Authority payable solely from certain revenues to be received by the Authority pursuant to an Amended and Restated Lease Contract (the Lease'') between Gwinnett County (the County'') and the Authority. The Lease
obligates the County to make certain payments to the Authority including payments sufficient to enable the

Authority to pay the principal of and interest on all Obligations issued by the Authority (including the Prior Obligations). The County's obligations under the Lease are absolute and unconditional and are secured by a pledge of the County's full faith and credit and taxing power.
Additional Information: A Preliminary Official Statement in a form deemed final, a Notice of Sale and Official Bid Form has been mailed to a list of prospective bidders.

Additional copies of such information is available request to Joseph E. Lay, Evensen Dodge, Inc., 1010 Monarch Plaza, 3414 Peachtree Road, N.E., Atlanta Georgia 30326, telephone (404) 233-0292, the financial advisor.
Donald Camp
Chairman,
Gwinnett County Water and Sewerage
Authority
(From The Bond Buyer)
